temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days, which is uncharacteristic. When Carolyn asks about it, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and personal stuff.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging, and Carolyn has no specific explanation for why she might be acting differently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Carolyn's concern is confirmed: Marilyn is not merely quiet by chance but is dealing with work and personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is overwhelmed by work and personal issues, but has not shared details. Carolyn should be supportive without pushing too hard.
temporal_state_chain.intention: offer support and make herself available if Marilyn wants to talk

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn was curt in a later interaction, which confused and hurt Carolyn. When Carolyn gently addresses it and shares her own experiences, Marilyn apologizes and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed she had responded supportively to Marilyn's stress and hoped Marilyn would feel helped rather than offended.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's curtness was likely caused by her difficult week, not by Carolyn overstepping or damaging the relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn appreciates Carolyn's openness and support; the distance was not personal, and Marilyn is still receptive to Carolyn's friendship.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: confusion and hurt, then relief and understanding
temporal_state_chain.intention: clear up any misunderstanding and continue being supportive and patient with Marilyn

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness, and when Carolyn invites her to a small weekend gathering, Marilyn accepts warmly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes she and Marilyn are building trust and a friendship after resolving the earlier misunderstanding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's acceptance confirms that she values the connection and is willing to socialize outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their friendship is progressing, and Marilyn is interested in strengthening the bond.
temporal_state_chain.intention: host the gathering and use it to deepen her friendship with Marilyn

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Marilyn still seems to maintain professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this directly, Marilyn says she did not realize it and is willing to talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed their growing friendship might naturally improve or carry over into their working relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: There is a gap between their personal friendliness and workplace dynamic, but Marilyn appears open to addressing it rather than rejecting Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The work relationship needs clearer understanding and boundaries; Marilyn is willing to improve collaboration, so the distance may be unintentional.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: disappointment, then cautious reassurance and hope
temporal_state_chain.intention: discuss their work dynamic openly and work toward better professional collaboration

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn feels they have cleared the air. When she proposes teaming up on a new project, Marilyn agrees enthusiastically and says she looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they now better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries, and she feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's positive response confirms that the improved understanding is mutual and that she welcomes closer collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is stronger; Carolyn believes they can work well together on the project and continue building trust.
temporal_state_chain.intention: team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership
